_comment: Nightly full-scope mutation scope (W1-T133, MASTER-PLAN §5/D-10). `mutate` mirrors stryker.conf.json's own `mutate` key syntax (a flat glob array; a `!`-prefixed entry is an exclusion) but widened to the WHOLE src/** tree instead of the PR gate's single classify.ts target -- this is what lets the nightly workflow own the global mutation score while stryker.conf.json (untouched by this task) keeps the PR gate diff-scoped. `!src/**/*.test.ts` is belt-and-suspenders: test/** already sits outside src/** so it can never match this glob anyway, and scripts/mutation-ratchet.mjs's resolveMutateScope() ALSO hard-excludes `test/**` unconditionally regardless of what this file says -- a test file is never a mutation target in either scope, enforced twice. `fileCap` bounds how many of the matched files any SINGLE nightly run mutates (the ~4-hour full-tree run this task exists to keep off the PR path); scripts/mutation-ratchet.mjs's `--nightly-scope` mode deterministically samples down to this cap, keyed on the day-of-year, so the sample ROTATES and the whole matched set is covered once every ceil(matched-file-count / fileCap) nights -- never a silent partial-coverage-forever.
